## Summary

Describe the user-visible change or maintenance problem and the approach taken.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe API, default, toolchain or protocol changes. Link the updated guide or
explain why none is needed. Note any changes to parity mappings or exclusions.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. Distinguish full native runs,
filtered tests, static checks and checks not run. Link exact-commit CI evidence.

## Preservation

For moved or retired files, identify their new location or commit-pinned history.
Do not discard tests, active baselines or applicable license notices.
